searchHint: Search the records you may read by reference, name, title or captured contact. Personal search text stays in this form.
scoped: Results use your current record access. Each destination checks access again.
noResults: No matching records you can access.
moreResults: Results are bounded; narrow the search or open the matching queue.
notificationHint: Today shows current work requiring attention. Counts describe current queues; they do not claim anything is unread.
replyReview: I reviewed the recipient, source facts and this draft.
nativeBoundary: This opens your email app. Nothing is sent by this workspace. Check the recipient and send it yourself, then record the contact actually made.
replyLocal: Draft in this page only. It has not been sent or saved as a communication.
draftOnly: Nothing is sent or published by Butler. A person owns the next action.
sourceChanged: The source changed; review it before using this draft.
manualReconcile: Check the existing request before taking another action.
noActivity: No recorded activity for this deal yet.
unknownReason: Review the recorded reason in technical details.

inventory.rentalBoundary: These are recorded source terms for human review. Missing charges are unknown, never zero; availability is not a booking confirmation.
inventory.rentalUnreadable: The recorded value needs review before this editor can display it.

correction.title: Material correction
correction.boundary: Record the disputed fact and source, restrict inaccurate exposure, then reconcile each affected item. Replacement facts, owner review, messages and publication each keep their ordinary human approval.
correction.scope: This is a current authorized source snapshot. Previous downloads cannot be recalled; alerts, comparisons, saves and manual copies require their own review.
correction.confirmOpen: I reviewed this impact and authorize restriction of the current public exposure.
correction.confirmReconcile: I reviewed every current impact item. Unresolved work remains assigned to me.
correction.pending: Owner or source verification is still required; keep this item unresolved.
correction.savedDetail: Open the current correction workspace to review its recorded state.
correction.failed: The correction was not recorded. Review current access, source and revision.
correction.unknown: The result is not confirmed. Check this same request before retrying.
correction.emptyReceipt: No receipt is recorded for this request. Review the current workspace before retrying.
correction.noReason: The original source did not record further evidence.

kinds.derived: Search, alerts, comparison and saved views
